describe: change the colour or size of something already in the game, like the asteroids or enemies
guide: Find that thing's own colour and size constants near the top (like ASTEROID_COLOUR and ASTEROID_SIZE) and change those numbers. If it has none, give it named constants and use them where it is drawn.
report: I made the $things $how -- $changed at the top $were what changed.
teach: Every one of them is drawn from the same ${prefix}_ constants, so one change reaches them all.
